instruction: Tidy up my desk: pens stand upright in the magenta pen holder, the mug goes on the blue coaster, notebooks go on the orange tray, and crumpled paper balls go into the red wastebasket. Some things are already where they belong; leave them there.

attempts.code:
# Grasp cyan_pen and place it upright into magenta_holder
candidates = grasp_candidates("cyan_pen")
# Choose a candidate across the short side (typically source=="geometry" with score 0.5 or clear)
cand = candidates[0]
for c in candidates:
    if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True) and c.get("hand_clear", True):
        cand = c
        break

grasp(cand)

obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy, hz = holder["center"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)
table_z = obs["table_z"]

# Move above the holder safely clear of its rim
carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.12)

# Orient or lower into holder; for placing a pen upright in a cup/holder, lowering into the cup and opening releases it
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("cyan_pen", "magenta_holder")

# Look at current state: cyan_pen is resting across the rim of magenta_holder
obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["cyan_pen"]
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy, hz = holder["center"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)

# Find grasp candidates for cyan_pen
candidates = grasp_candidates("cyan_pen")
# Grasp candidate near an end or clear
# We want to pick up the pen near one end so it can tilt/stand vertically into the holder
best_cand = None
max_dist = -1.0
cx, cy, _ = pen["center"]
for c in candidates:
    if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True):
        dist = math.hypot(c["x"] - cx, c["y"] - cy)
        if dist > max_dist:
            max_dist = dist
            best_cand = c

if best_cand is None:
    best_cand = candidates[0]

grasp(best_cand)

# Carry above magenta_holder
carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.15)
# Lower partially into the holder and open gripper so the pen drops/stands inside
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("cyan_pen", "magenta_holder")

obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy, _ = holder["center"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)

candidates = grasp_candidates("cyan_pen")
# Find a grasp candidate that is clear, or choose one with sufficient height above the rim
best_cand = None
for c in candidates:
    if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True) and c.get("hand_clear", False) and c.get("fingers_clear", False):
        best_cand = c
        break

    # Filter candidates with height well above the rim

        if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True) and c.get("height", 0) >= rim_h - 0.01:

            break

res = grasp(best_cand)

# Move directly above the center of magenta_holder at a safe height
carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.16)

# Lower until contact (the pen will hit bottom/rim and slide/stand vertically)
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("cyan_pen", "magenta_holder")
